title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Watermelon Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Watermelon Ice delivers a refreshing take on a classic fruit flavour. Each inhale reveals the light and subtly sweet taste of ripe Watermelon, followed by a cooling Menthol finish that leaves a crisp and revitalising sensation. This well-balanced blend offers a clean, satisfying vape with a chilled edge. Renowned for crafting distinctive and bold e-liquid flavours, Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Bar Salts range is designed to replicate the punchy intensity of disposable vape flavours. Each blend is double-concentrated to ensure a lasting, full-bodied taste while delivering a consistently smooth vaping experience. Blended at 50VG/50PG, these Nic Salts provide a balance between vapour production and rich flavour, making them perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine absorption, even at higher strengths. Watermelon Ice is best suited for classic vape starter kits and low-powered pod systems, ensuring a satisfying vape every time. Since launching in 2016, Dinner Lady has become one of the most recognised e-liquid brands in the UK, famous for crafting nostalgic and innovative flavours. With global distribution in over 80 countries, Dinner Lady continues to be a leader in the vaping industry, offering expertly blended e-liquids made with high-quality ingredients.
